text:
deploybot: Scheduled deploy window: service-inference v3.4.2 -> prod (canary 22:00 UTC, ramp 22:30).
incident-bot: New incident created INC-7893: eu-west region KV cache errors (inflight ops failing).
jen: heard about INC-7893 — ops asked to hold any prod rollouts touching kv-cache.
mike: thanks — we were about to promote v3.4.2 which includes the new long-prefix cache rewrite.
priya: can we scope the risk? is it only reads or also writes?
ops_lead: writes impacted. risk of kv tombstones during compaction. request: pause all releases that touch cache migrations.
jen: acknowledged. @deploybot please pause the v3.4.2 rollout and pin the release slot to v3.4.1 for safe rollback.
deploybot: Command received: `pause rollout service-inference v3.4.2` — Rollout paused. Slot pinned to v3.4.1.
mike: logging plan: if rollback needed run `deploybot promote service-inference v3.4.1 --force --reason "kv-incident"` — ops ready for target time.
priya: also flagging QA: hold release notes publish until incident triage. we don't want customers seeing broken diff.
jen: agreed. action items: 1) ops triage INC-7893, ETA 30m. 2) release team to keep v3.4.2 in quarantine and prepare rollback playbook. 3) postpone change window notification to stakeholders.
ops_lead: triage update: suspect compaction path; working mitigation to disable background compaction in eu cluster (non-prod test looks promising).
priya: if compaction disable looks clean, can we schedule a staggered rerun in 90m with small canary?
mike: +1. prepare canary checklist and throttling params. I'd prefer 5% canary then 30% then ramp.
jen: scheduling note: change window moved from 22:00->01:00 UTC tentative, will confirm after triage. Jen will update release calendar.
incident-bot: INC-7893 updated: investigation in progress (labels: kv-cache, eu-west, high).
deploybot: Reminder: pinned slot prevents auto-promotion. To unpin run `deploybot unpin service-inference`.
ops_lead: if rollback required, do it ASAP and mark release 'quarantined' in release_notes.md.
priya: will draft a short internal blurb for sales & support once we know customer impact.
mike: copying rollback commands into runbook now.
jen: thanks — next update in 20m or on status change. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
priya: :thumbsup:
ops_lead: :mag:
jen: note — keep chatter here, no need to escalate to leadership unless customer-facing incidents start appearing.
